messages:
Ava (PM): Quick sync — Major customer (FinServCo) asked for per-tenant cost breakdown + trace-linked error buckets in the Console. They want a canary by end of next sprint. Can we scope this without blowing the perf budget?
Diego (Eng): Need clarity: is the ask for live per-request cost attribution or a sampled cost rollup? live attribution at token granularity will be expensive.
Priya (CS): Customer wants 'near real-time' for billing ops — ~5m latency acceptable. Key is tie errors -> traces -> cost for specific tenant features.
Sam (Eng-ML): For traces+errors, we can attach trace ids to error events and aggregate. Cost attribution we can do as rollups using route+model weights, sampling traces for heavy customers.
Ava (PM): Proposal: MVP = 1) per-tenant cost rollups every 5m, 2) trace hooks that include tenant_id and cost-estimate tag, 3) error buckets linked to trace ids. Launch criteria: accuracy within 10% for rollups, SLOs unaffected (p99 latency delta < 5ms).
Diego (Eng): Sounds reasonable. Tech caveat: rollout requires a new tag in the runtime and a small tracing hook in the mux. Perf risk mostly on high-throughput tenants. Need sampling defaults.
Sam (Eng-ML): Suggest sampling config like: 
```yaml
sampling:
  default: 0.02
  high_volume_routes: 0.001
  tenant_overrides:
    finservco-prod: 0.05
```
This keeps overhead bounded but gives richer signals for targeted tenants.
Priya (CS): Customer asked for higher fidelity for one tenant only — finservco-prod. That sampling looks good. They also want a dashboard slice that shows cost/error correlation for their top 5 routes.
Ava (PM): UX ask: dashboard should let them toggle sampling window and see raw trace samples for a selected time range. We'll ship a templateset for 'tenant-cost-insight' so SEs can onboard quickly.
Diego (Eng): Implementation tasks I see: 1) add tenant_id and cost_estimate tags in runtime (ENG-RUN-422), 2) tracing hook + sampling controller (ENG-TRC-310), 3) telemetry pipeline change to emit rollups (ENG-PIPE-198), 4) Console UI template + widgets (FE-OBS-121).
Ava (PM): Prioritization question: do we block other visibility work? My take: treat as a scoped feature flagged canary — do not re-prioritize whole observability roadmap. Two sprints to get a canary to the customer.
Sam (Eng-ML): Need an eval plan: collect sampled traces + rollups for 2 weeks, compare against invoice-level totals to validate the 10% accuracy goal.
Priya (CS): I'll coordinate with the customer for canary testing window and dataset access. Also confirm legal/PII constraints for trace samples.
Diego (Eng): One more: add quota guard — if sampling rate spikes for a tenant accidentally, auto-throttle. We can reuse existing rate-limiter.
ops-bot: deploy-scheduler: Canary window scheduled: 2026-04-12T22:00Z -> 2026-04-19T22:00Z for finservco-prod (flagged).
Ava (PM): Action items: Priya (coordinate customer), Diego (runtime + hooks), Sam (sampling policy + eval), FE (console template). I'll add tickets and a lightweight PRD. Checkpoint next Tue standup. :thumbsup:
